scope: New synthetic state model and browser interaction only; not the twelve referenced systems as an integrated platform.

browser_source_verification.method: Playwright set_content with the exact HTML and inline substitution of the exact engine. Local file navigation was blocked by the execution environment.
browser_source_verification.coverage: Four scenarios, false closure, source replay, reopening, review invalidation, JSON export, reset, keyboard expansion, reduced motion, markup escaping, console errors and horizontal overflow.
browser_source_verification.does_not_establish: Public HTTPS delivery, external-link availability, Safari or Firefox compatibility. Deployment must be checked independently.
browser_source_verification.note: The 41 source-level checks bind the recorded offline_combined_html hash before repository formatting. Final deployed-browser verification is separate.

repairs: Reject altered speaker, source kind, text or parent under an unchanged source revision.
Reject self-verification when the accepted owner is named verifier.
Retain explicit reply-parent context and reviewed-source identity.
Invalidate earlier adjudication when new evidence arrives.
Preserve existing receipt and version on a duplicate customer-update action.
not_verified: Automatic transcript extraction or semantic classification accuracy
Real server-side authorization, durable storage or multi-user concurrency
Live HubSpot writes, external delivery or exactly-once provider effects
Customer-scale capacity, adoption or business outcomes
Fresh full test suites of the twelve referenced projects
privacy: Synthetic workflow only; private client correspondence and source paths omitted. Public page requests are not private. Noindex is not access control.
